aspects.description: Battery endurance, standby time, and battery degradation over time.
Phone design, shape, weight, color options, material durability, casing scratches, and paint peeling.
Screen size, resolution, color depth, brightness, and visual clarity.
Photo and video quality, camera resolution, low-light performance, and shooting features.
Speaker volume, ringtone quality, sound distortion at high volumes, and call audio quality.
Processing speed, lagging, freezing, system crashes, storage capacity, and software stability. Also built-in software: messaging, contacts, input method, media playback.
Signal strength, network connectivity, and dual-card switching capability.
Keypad design, tactile feedback, durability of physical buttons, sliding mechanism, and touch control usability.
Overall cost-effectiveness and perceived value relative to the price.
Returns, repairs, warranty, invoices, refurbished or non-genuine units, customer support

edits: Added after-sales & authenticity (6 of 150 sampled phone reviews mention returns/repairs/invoices/refurbished units); folded software features into performance. Did not add delivery: 0 of 150 phone reviews mention it, so the LLM was right to leave it out.
